title: Garrett Wilson: I want to win, hopeful I can do it with Jets

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Garrett Wilson: I want to win, hopeful I can do it with Jets
sources.description: Jets wide receiver Garrett Wilson's frustrations boiled over on the sideline during last Sunday's loss to the Dolphins, but he said on Wednesday that he's not looking for a move to another team ahead of the November 10 trade deadline.
